description: Fifth story/chapter pointer table discovered at ROM offset 0x53C3C0. 9 entries of u32 pointers to chapter data.
notes: Fifth story/chapter pointer table with 9 entries. The target data starts with 0xBE 0x66 0xBC 0x00 which is similar to the other story tables. This suggests the game has five separate story/chapter systems. Located in the 0x53Cxxx region between the other story tables and the map headers. The first entry points to 0x464C5C which has a different structure (starts with 0x003C), suggesting it's a header or special entry.
verification_method: Static analysis - found 9 consecutive u32 pointers at 0x53C3C0, all pointing to valid ROM addresses. Target data starts with 0xBE 0x66 0xBC 0x00 pattern consistent with chapter data.
discovered_by: Examining region 0x53C000-0x53D000 between story tables and map headers
